steps.npc: You may or may not be aware, but a plague has spread across West Ardougne. Now, so far, our efforts to contain it have been largely successful, for the most part.
However, some sheep recently escaped from a farm near the city. When they were found, we noticed that they were strangely discoloured, so we asked the mourners to examine them.
They believe that the sheep have become infected with the plague.

steps.player: Are you sure it's the plague?

steps.npc: Well the mourners seemed convinced and they're the experts. Even if it's not though, the sheep are clearly diseased in some way.
As the councillor responsible for public health and safety here in East Ardougne, I am in charge of dealing with this problem.
We need someone to herd these sheep into a safe enclosure, kill them quickly and cleanly and then dispose of the remains hygienically in a special incinerator.
Unfortunately, nobody wants to risk catching the plague, and I am unable to find someone willing to undertake this mission for me.

steps.player: I can do that for you.

steps.npc: You will? That is excellent news! Head to the enclosure we have set up on Farmer Brumty's land to the north of the city; the four infected sheep should still be somewhere in that vicinity.
Before you will be allowed to enter the enclosure, however, you must ensure you have some kind of protective clothing to prevent contagion.

steps.player: Where can I find some protective clothing then?

steps.npc: Doctor Orbon should have something suitable. You should be able to find him in the chapel just north of here.
Please also take this poisoned sheep feed; we believe poisoning the sheep will minimise the risk of airborne contamination, and is of course also more humane to the sheep.

steps.text: The councillor gives you some poisoned sheep feed.

steps.player: How will I know which sheep are infected?

steps.npc: The poor creatures have developed strangely discoloured wool and flesh. You should have no trouble spotting them. There should be four in total.

steps.player: That's not a job for me.

steps.npc: I do not blame you adventurer. It is not particularly pleasant work. My problem remains however. If you know of anyone suitable please send them this way; time is of the essence.
That's what concerns me... There might not be much life around here soon.

standard-dialogue-after-sheep-herder.npc: Well hello again adventurer! How are you today?
I'm okay. Sadly some more diseased sheep have appeared so I have them to deal with.

standard-dialogue-after-sheep-herder.player: Do you need me to help again?

standard-dialogue-after-sheep-herder.npc: Thank you for the kind offer. You've done enough though. We'll find someone else to deal with these ones.

standard-dialogue-after-sheep-herder-whi.npc: Hello, is there any news about how our sheep keep getting infected with the plague?

standard-dialogue-after-sheep-herder-whi.player: Not that I know of, sorry.

standard-dialogue-after-sheep-herder-whi.npc: I'd sure like to know why we can't contain it. Please raise the issue next time you see the Head Mourner.

standard-dialogue-after-song-of-the-elve.npc: Well hello again adventurer! How are you today?
Not too bad, I've a lot to do though. King Lathas left plenty of things for us to clean up.
